t: Din yom tob sheni shel galuyyot
s: Din yom tob sheni shel galuyyot ubo y"a seipim: begaluyyot sheosin shene yamim tobim missapeq, kol mah sheasur laasot barishon — asur laasot bashsheni. Vekol hamchallel yom tob sheni bemezid, ben bedabar sheasur laasoto barishon min hattora, ben bedabar sheasur laasoto barishon middibre soperim, kegon sheyyatza chutz lattechum vekayyotze bazeh — menaddin oto.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Beyom tob sheni sheiqqaro middibre soperim, ukeshemmechallelo apillu bedabar shehu middibre soperim — hare oqer lekol hammitzva, shehare iqqaro eno ella middibre soperim, laken menaddin oto. Abal dabar sheiqqaro min hattora, kegon yom tob rishon — en menaddin oto, ella im ken asa bo melaka haasura min hattora. Abal im chillelo bedabar sheissuro eno ella middibre soperim — en menaddin oto, ella makkin oto makkat mardut. Veim asa al pi horaat chakam shettaa o sheasa beshogeg — en malqin veen menaddin oto, apillu chillelo bedabar sheissuro min hattora.
Kol maqom shehu chayyab nidduy, im hu talmid chakam — en menaddin oto, ella makkin oto makkat mardut.

En chilluq ben rishon lashsheni ella leinyan met, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqk"v. Veken likchol et haayin, ap al pi sheen bo sakkana im lo yikchol, kegon shekkebar hitchila haayin lehitrappeot, dibyom tob rishon en likchol ella al yede nokri, mikkol maqom bashsheni muttar likchol apillu al yede yisrael, kevan sheyyesh bo qetzat choli, ap al pi sheen hacholi kolel et kol haggup.

Veen tzarik lomar shemmuttar laasot kol shebut middibre soperim lemi sheyyesh lo michush shemmitztaer vechala mimmennu kol gupo, beinyan sheapillu beyom tob rishon muttar laasot lo shebut middibre soperim al yede shinnuy kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"ch, ubeyom tob sheni en tzarik shinnuy kelal. Chutz miyyom tob sheni shel rosh hashshana, sheen chilluq beno leyom rishon ella leinyan met bilbad kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqk"v, mittaam sheyyitbaer besimman t"r ayyen sham. Abal dabar sheissuro min hattora — asur laasot lo al yede yisrael apillu beyom tob sheni, vaapillu chala kol gupo, im en bo sakkana.
Mi shennapal venitzrar haddam — asur lehaqqiz dam sheqqorin qepapi"n apillu al yede nokri, mippene sheepshar lehamtin ad lemotzae yom tob.

Bene eretz yisrael shebbau lechutz laaretz — asurim laasot melaka beyom tob sheni beyishshub yisrael apillu betzina, vaapillu bammidbar im hu tok hattechum leir sheyyisrael darin bah, vaapillu datam lachazor limqomam, mittaam shennitbaer besimman ts"ch. Umikkol maqom, im asu melaka — en menaddin veen malqin otam, kevan sheddatam lachazor limqoman.

Im chal yom tob sheni beereb shabbat — enam tzerikim leareb erube tabshilin, mippene shehu dabar shebbetzina, velaken en tzarik linhog bazeh kechumre hammaqom shehalak lesham, kevan sheddato lachazor (ayyen simman ts"ch). Umittaam zeh tzerikim hem lehitpallel tepillat shemoneh esreh belachash beyom tob sheni, veken lehaniach tepillin betzina, kevan sheddata[m] lachazor, notenim alehem chumre hammaqom sheyyatzeu mishsham, kemo shennitbaer besimman ts"ch. Abal tzerikim lilbosh malbushe yom tob, mippene shehu dabar shel parhesya.

Abal im en datam lachazor limqoman, im higgiu tok techum leir meayarot shebbechutz laaretz, apillu en bair yisrael — naasu kibne chutz laaretz miyyad, vaasurin laasot melaka beyom tob sheni, ben tok hattechum ben chutz lattechum, umitpalelin kibne chutz laaretz, veken tzerikim leareb erub tabshilin kibne chutz laaretz. Abal kol zeman shello higgiu letok hattechum shel ir meayarot shel chutz laaretz — adayin lo huqbeu lihyot kibne chutz laaretz, umuttarim laasot melaka beyom tob sheni, vahare hem adayin kibne eretz yisrael lekol dabar.
Haoqer dirato im ishto meeretz yisrael lechutz laaretz, ap al pi sheddato lachazor dino kemi sheen dato lachazor.

Bene chutz laaretz shebbau leeretz yisrael, ap al pi sheddatan lachazor — en osin ella yom echad kibne eretz yisrael. Veyesh choleqin. Kol mi sheen dato lachazor limqomo ap al pi sheishto nishara bimqomo — niqra en dato lachazor.
